decisions.reason: As a core encrypted communication channel, it remains cheap to keep and strategically valuable, so the option is worth retaining.
Digital signature is a natural adjacent use of the firm's authentication expertise and still holds enough option value to justify keeping.
A foundational security architecture underpins multiple future offerings and has low keeping cost relative to its strategic option value.
The email-to-app robot is peripheral, higher cost to keep, and after four years without clear traction its option value is likely no longer enough to justify staying.
